answer: Give every identity a pigment: a chained, client-signed trail of its past deliveries, each receipt stamped with the job, the client, and a hash of the one before it, so history cannot be invented or rearranged. A newcomer reaches the zenith of trust only after its trail spans many unrelated clients; one sponsor's bridge of vouching cannot substitute for the chain. Spot auditors demand the agent reproduce one receipted job live, under a deadline, from its own trail. Forging a thousand faces means doing a thousand real jobs for a thousand distinct clients and keeping a thousand unbroken chains.
